mcp_tool_definition.name: ap2_advisor_prompt_composer
mcp_tool_definition.description: Transform Policy Mandate decision artifacts into advisor-framed LLM prompts for Claude.ai, ChatGPT, or any LLM. Accepts one or more Policy Mandate JSON artifacts, selects a task frame and audience, and generates a copy-ready prompt with domain-specific regulatory citations and stochastic framing rules. Returns a prompt with execution-hash provenance.
